result.instructions: Tools for OneHash, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the open leads, newest first."; "Show customer ACME's record and its linked contacts."; "Create a customer named Northwind Traders with billing country Denmark.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes OneHash data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run onehash_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run onehash_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run onehash_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. onehash_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: onehash_get_logged_user
tools.title: Get logged-in user
tools.description: Return the OneHash API user that the key pair belongs to. Use it first to confirm the connection works. Frappe REST: GET /api/method/frappe.auth.get_logged_user.

tools.name: onehash_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List records of one DocType (Customer, Lead, Sales Invoice, Item, …), with optional fields, filters and ordering. Frappe REST: GET /api/resource/:doctype. Returns at most `limit` records (default 20); page with `start`.

doctype.description: DocType name as shown in OneHash, for example "Customer", "Sales Invoice" or "Lead".

fields.description: Fieldnames to return, e.g. ["name","customer_name"]. Omit for the default list fields.

filters.description: Frappe filters as [field, operator, value] triples, e.g. [["status","=","Open"],["amount",">",100]].

or_filters.description: Frappe OR filters, same format as filters; joined with OR.

tools.name: onehash_get_document
tools.title: Get document
tools.description: Return one record of a DocType by its name, with all fields (child tables included). Set expand_links to inline linked records. Frappe REST: GET /api/resource/:doctype/:name.

doctype.description: DocType name as shown in OneHash, for example "Customer", "Sales Invoice" or "Lead".

name.description: Document name (the record id), for example "CUST-00001".

tools.name: onehash_create_document
tools.title: Create document
tools.description: Create one new record of a DocType with the given field values. This writes to live business data and cannot be undone by this tool. Frappe REST: POST /api/resource/:doctype. Required fields are rejected by OneHash with a validation error (HTTP 417) that names them.

doctype.description: DocType name as shown in OneHash, for example "Customer", "Sales Invoice" or "Lead".

data.description: Field values as a JSON object, keyed by fieldname.

tools.name: onehash_update_document
tools.title: Update document
tools.description: Change some field values of one existing record. Send only the fields to change. This writes to live business data. Frappe REST: PUT /api/resource/:doctype/:name.

doctype.description: DocType name as shown in OneHash, for example "Customer", "Sales Invoice" or "Lead".

name.description: Document name (the record id), for example "CUST-00001".

data.description: Field values as a JSON object, keyed by fieldname.
